message: 魅惑のブドウ

name: Sacchin
message: 「So anyway, that grape-picking trip was just terrible!」
An after-school classroom.
In a rare turn of events, Sacchin has gone into complaining mode, leaving Nanaka and me to play the listeners.

name: Synn
message: 「I've never been grape picking before. I've gone mandarin picking, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I haven't done grapes either. I went strawberry picking a bunch of times when I was a kid, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I was with you back then. Holding a paper cup of milk in one hand, plucking fresh strawberries and dipping them in--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha! Yeah, yeah, by the end it always turns into strawberry milk!」

name: Synn
message: 「You used to love cow's milk so much back then, Nanaka... When did you start refusing it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's your fault I ended up like this! Making me drink tons of that white stuff every single day... U-Ughhh!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Jeez! Stop flirting and listen to my story! Hmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, we aren't messing around or anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, what was it again? Grape picking, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Couldn't we have gone as an activity for the Sweets Club?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's no way I could do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I knew from the very start it wouldn't be fun. I couldn't invite Nana-chan and Yumil along!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why'd you even go?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「My mom is super strict, so the whole family has to properly do family trips together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Properly do a family trip?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin has a ton of siblings, after all~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah. Apparently we got about four more just last month!」
H-How active can they get...

name: Sacchin
message: 「So anyway. You know how loofahs and stuff are grown by letting them vine across a trellis overhead?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, we grow them like that at my place.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was like that, with tons of grapes hanging all over the orchard, and it was all-you-can-pick, all-you-can-eat!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That sounds amazing, doesn't it?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「B-But the ceiling's only 160 centimeters high--」

name: Synn
message: 「So you have to stay hunched over the whole time you're picking? Still, if it's all-you-can-eat, I could put up with that much.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There are still way more traps--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There aren't any benches anywhere, no toilets or washrooms either, and of course no towels or anything at all--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, yikes, that's brutal.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I ended up causing trouble for everyone instead, *sigh*」

name: Synn
message: 「...Everyone?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Wait, setting me and Synn aside, with your height, Sacchin, wouldn't you not even need to crouch?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's so offensive--I wanna grow taller too--」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it, I totally get it, Sacchin. I'm on the shorter side myself... *sniffle*. If milk will help, I'll buy you as many cartons as you want.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks--but I wanna get bigger while keeping the same height difference with Nana-chan--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you thinking about something so complicated?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh--? Because if Nana-chan looks down just a little, and I tilt my face up like *this*, we can have the ideal kiss, right--?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I see, so that's why.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go getting impressed, I'm not into girls, y'know!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If it's with Nana-chan... I don't mind... mm--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't close your eyes, and don't pucker your lips!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha. Before we knew it, this stopped being a complaint session, huh.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't complain about my friends--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you totally were?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's so offensive--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everything up till now was just the lead-in so I could take Nana-chan out to eat delicious grape sweets, I'm telling you--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That lead-in was way too long!!」
The topic kept jumping all over the place after that too, but an hour and a half later, Sacchin somehow managed to get around to asking Nanaka out.
...For some reason, I ended up exhausted.
